sentences.text: during patrolling duty, the complainant received information  that vehicle containing tobacco and gutaka will be passing from  Versova police outpost.
PSI-Gaikwad and his team went to Versova  village road.
One Eicher container bearing No. MH-02-ER-8749 was  Ganesh Lokhande 2 of 4 aba-1018-2020.doc passing through the road.
Police stopped the vehicle and made enquiry with driver and cleaner.
They informed that they are carrying consignment of sarees in the container.

On inspection,
boxes containing sarees were noticed.
On further inspection, bags containing gutaka were noticed.
After enquiry with a driver about contents of container, he stated that goods were being transported from Surat, Gujarat to Bandra, Mumbai.
Police seized the container.
FIR was registered.
3. The applicant preferred an application for anticipatory bail before the Court of Sessions, which was rejected by Order dated 9th October, 2020.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
There is nothing to be recovered from the applicant.
He had allegedly transported all the articles, seized by the police.
The applicant is not named in the FIR.
He has been implicated on the basis of statement of co-accused.
He was merely the owner of the truck.
He has cooperated with the investigation.

Driver and cleaner were arrested on 10 th September,
2020.
They were produced before the concerned Court for remand.

sentences.text: They were remanded to police custody for sometime and thereafter to judicial custody.

They were granted bail by the Court of learned  Ganesh Lokhande 3 of 4 aba-1018-2020.doc Judicial Magistrate, Thane.
5.
Learned APP submitted that the applicant's involvement is supported by evidence.
The applicant is in the business of transport and he is also owner of the vehicle.
The arrested accused were working as a driver.
Cleaner on the vehicle had disclosed involvement of the applicant.
They have stated that goods were loaded as per directions of the applicant and he knows the source of goods.
The applicant is prime accused.
His custodial interrogation is necessary.

6. Learned APP relied upon the decision of this Court in the case of Vinod Ramnath Gupta V/s. State of Maharashtra dated 6th November, 2020 and submitted that this Court has held that Section 328 of IPC is attracted in such cases and application was rejected.

sentences.text: He also pointed out that investigation papers and the documents which shows that the vehicle used in the crime is in the name of applicant.

7. The prosecution case is that, on receipt of information,
the container with the goods as stated above, was intercepted.
Driver and the cleaner were arrested.
They tried to mislead investigating agency.
However, on further interrogation gutka and tobacco was found.
The value of goods was Rs.18,06,400/-.
The documents shows that the vehicle is owned by the applicant.

Hence, no case is made out for grant of anticipatory bail.
8. Hence, I pass the following order.
ORDER (i) Anticipatory Bail Application No.1018 of 2020, is rejected and disposed of accordingly.
(ii) This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
